scope: Comparison intake only; no runtime, mirror, active policy, or tested pin promotion

gate_semantics.source_verified: Official stable release and tagged top-level license inspected; not a full dependency/security audit
gate_semantics.fit_pass: Reviewer assessment against existing lean core-runtime strategy
gate_semantics.hold: Required live or migration evidence missing; not a tested regression failure
gate_semantics.promotion: Requires version-bound evidence for all required checks; static review alone cannot promote

candidates.name: Codex
fit_reasons: MCP account-bound approvals and recovery are useful to the existing primary runtime.

required_checks.name: macOS relative MCP launch and account-switch approval isolation
resume/compaction/reconnect preserves policy and avoids duplicate execution
portable project instructions and skills; representative task quality and usage

rollout_conditions: Keep experimental context management disabled in the portable baseline.
Retain sandbox and explicit approvals; Full Access changes review behavior.

candidates.name: Claude Code

managed/user MCP allow/deny migration and malformed-policy refusal
stop/resume and concurrent sessions without duplicate agents or config loss

rollout_conditions: Remain reference_only, review_required, and sync_policy none.
Audit managed MCP exclusions before rollout.

candidates.name: Kimi Code
